note: NECO Literature round 4 (R28 top-up): aside, comic relief, foil, hamartia, hubris, deus ex machina, climax, exposition, farce; blank verse, free verse, enjambment, caesura, dramatic monologue, antithesis, epigram, imagery, symbolism, tone, lyric, epic and griot; antagonist, round character, satire, verbal and situational irony, subplot, first-person narration, novella; Tutuola's Palm-Wine Drinkard, Okri's Famished Road, Adichie's Half of a Yellow Sun, Nwapa's Efuru, Ngugi's Weep Not, Child, Soyinka's Death and the King's Horseman, Rotimi's Kurunmi, Saro-Wiwa's Sozaboy. Scanned against NECO rounds 1-3, WAEC Literature (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
